bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · lost the 30-day average
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 跌破 30 日均线

read.en: AMD fell 1.5% on Oct 15 to $562.23 on above-average volume, recovering from an intraday low of $530.09. It is below its 5-day ($588.2), 10-day ($612.3) and rising 30-day ($575.8) averages but above the 100-day ($525.5) and 200-day ($392.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 with a widening histogram, still above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($637.2), and RSI is 44.5.
read.zh: AMD 10月15日在成交量高于平均的情况下下跌 1.5%，收于 $562.23，盘中从 $530.09 低点回升。股价位于 5 日（$588.2）、10 日（$612.3）和上行的 30 日均线（$575.8）下方，但在 100 日（$525.5）和 200 日均线（$392.7）上方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，柱状图扩大，仍在零轴之上；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$637.2），RSI 为 44.5。

read.en: The $567–572 zone (30-day average, Oct 13–14 lows) broke on the close and now caps at $567–576, with the late-September pivot at $588–590 above. The intraday drop held $530, just above the 100-day average. Support is $530 (Oct 15 low), then $525 (August pivot, 100-day) and $495–498. A close below $525 would open $497; a close above $576 would target $590.
read.zh: $567–572 区域（30 日均线、10月13–14日低点）收盘失守，现于 $567–576 形成压制，其上为 $588–590 的 9月下旬转折点。盘中跌势守在 $530，略高于 100 日均线。支撑为 $530（10月15日低点），其次 $525（8月转折点、100 日均线）和 $495–498。若收盘跌破 $525，下一目标看 $497；若收盘站上 $576，目标看 $590。

r.en: Oct 14 low and Oct 15 high ($567–568.6), former support
